newsitem.title: USA: Frost damage noted in two northern Iowa districts.
newsitem.headline: Frost damage noted in two northern Iowa districts.

text.p: The frost that occured September 14 was most extensive in Iowa's northwest and north central districts and crop damage ranged from very minimial to moderate, according to the state's agricultural statistics service weekly report.

Corn was less than two percent harvested as of Sunday, versus five percent a year ago and four percent average. Forty percent was rated mature and safe from frost damage versus 70 a year ago and 62 average. The crop was rated 18 percent excellent, 56 good, 22 fair, three poor and one very poor.

A few soybean fields had been harvested versus two percent a year ago and five average. Leaves were dropping on 34 percent of the crop, behind 49 percent a year ago and the 51 percent average. The crop was rated 12 percent excellent, 55 good, 26 fair, six poor and one very poor.
Topsoil moisture was rated one percent surplus, 58 adequate, 35 percent short and six very short. Subsoil moisture was rated one percent surplus, 57 adequate, 36 short and six very short.
